key_catalyst: Microsoft FQ4 blowout (revenue +18% to $90B, Azure +43% past $100B annualized, FCF $19.6B) driving QQQ's top holding sharply higher and easing AI capex-return fears
reasoning: Today's dominant catalyst is bullish and idiosyncratic: Microsoft's FQ4 beat with Azure growth accelerating and free cash flow of $19.6B directly rebutted the AI-capex-return fear that drove the 07-24 through 07-29 drawdown, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rallied roughly 7% after five sessions of heavy losses, reversing the China-lithography panic of 07-28 and 07-29. Meta's 7-9% drop on collapsing free cash flow and the hawkish 9-3 Fed hold with the 10-year at 4.70% are real drags, but both were absorbed in-session with QQQ still closing up 1.29%, so neither is an unabsorbed shock. The main overnight risk is Apple and Amazon reporting after the bell, which is a scheduled binary event rather than an escalating threat, and the market entered it after four straight down days rather than from an extended run.
